sql_text: SELECT /*+ FULL(o) */ o.*, c.customer_name FROM orders o, customers c WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.order_date BETWEEN TO_DATE('2024-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2024-12-31','YYYY-MM-DD')
SELECT customer_name, email FROM customers WHERE customer_id = 12345

SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 10000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
SELECT order_id, order_total FROM orders WHERE status = 'PENDING'
SELECT /*+ NO_INDEX(oi) */ oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date > SYSDATE - 365)
